title: Sonoran Cold Freight Billing: Invoice SCF-INV-90455 Past Due

fields.to: Carla Estrada, Director of Logistics; VP Supply Chain
fields.subject: Invoice SCF-INV-90455 – PAST DUE NOTICE
fields.body:
Good morning,

Invoice SCF-INV-90455 covers the October 8 spring mix shipment from Salinas to your Phoenix DC, which moved on 2 reefer trailers. It bills 26 pallets at the contract rate plus a $240 lumper fee at Phoenix receiving.

Your accounts payable short-paid the invoice to 24 pallets based on the BOL. Our signed delivery receipt shows 26 pallets unloaded. Because the balance is now past due, our system has placed Pinecrest Fresh Cut on credit review. Unless this is resolved, new dispatches after Friday, October 15, will need prepayment.

Please also confirm whether detention on today's load, truck 2219 / trailer SCF-53817, should be billed to this same account or to a separate reference. Our dispatch tells us the trailer may be held at the cold yard near Tucson.

The invoice and delivery receipt are attached. Please reply to this address or call the number below.

Thank you,
fields.signature:
Marisol V.
Accounts Receivable | Sonoran Cold Freight
555-0147 | billing@sonorancoldfreight.example

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. It is a billing dispute about a spring mix load and has nothing to do with the recall. VPSC and LOG should send it to accounts payable and ask for it to be settled before Friday so they keep carrier capacity. They should confirm only that any SCF-53817 detention goes to the recall cost code for the insurance claim, and they should not spend bridge time on it.
